title: Interval Bisection
author: 66b13dde02450b0e64029946
chapter_outcomes: Equations of the form f(x) = 0 solved numerically by: (i) interval bisection, (ii) linear interpolation, (iii) the Newton-Raphson process.
f(x) will involve only functions used in P1 and P2.
For the Newton-Raphson process, the only differentiation required will be as defined in unit P1 and P2.
